---
title: "RU Tree Master Table（RU 树总表）"
---

This appendix is a compact reference aligned with all eight Theme Toolbox chapters. It is not meant to replace the toolboxes—use it when you need to quickly locate a Theme, Group, or Associated Position.

## Theme Table

| Theme | Domain Language | Core Question |
|---|---|---|
| Body | condition, energy, signal, recovery | What physical condition is shaping this? |
| Mind | perception, attention, emotion, cognition, self | What inner process is active? |
| Language | word, sentence, concept, question, argument, instruction | What needs to be named, argued, or said? |
| Work | goal, plan, task, method, project, feedback | How does intention become action and result? |
| Relationship | access, trust, boundary, intimacy, repair, role | What is the arrangement between people? |
| Society | role, group, organization, institution, market, platform | What social structure is shaping this? |
| Technology | tool, software, AI model, data, system, automation, workflow | What mediates action technically? |
| Value | importance, benefit, cost, risk, purpose, standard, ethics, meaning | What matters and by what standard? |

## Group Table

Every Theme contains exactly eight Groups, matching Chapters 5–12:

| Theme | Groups (8 per Theme) |
|---|---|
| **Body** | Energy, Sleep, Diet, Movement, Health, Sensation, Stress, Fatigue & Pain |
| **Mind** | Perception, Attention, Memory, Emotion, Desire & Motivation, Cognition, Learning, Self |
| **Language** | Word & Phrase, Sentence, Text, Concept, Question, Argument, Narrative, Instruction |
| **Work** | Goal, Plan, Task, Method, Project, Practice, Problem, Feedback |
| **Relationship** | Connection, Trust, Boundary, Intimacy, Cooperation, Conflict, Influence, Relational Role |
| **Society** | Role, Group, Organization, Institution, Market, Rule, Career, Platform Ecology |
| **Technology** | Tool, Software, AI Model, Data, System, Technology Platform, Automation, Workflow |
| **Value** | Importance, Benefit, Cost, Risk, Purpose, Standard, Ethics, Meaning |

## Primary and Associated Position Examples

| Concept | Primary Position | Associated Positions |
|---|---|---|
| Sleep Debt | Body → Sleep | Mind → Attention; Work → Task |
| Cognitive Bias | Mind → Cognition | Language → Argument; Value → Standard |
| Prompt | Language → Instruction | Technology → Workflow; Work → Task |
| Feedback Loop | Work → Feedback | Technology → Automation; Mind → Learning |
| Personal Boundary | Relationship → Boundary | Body → Sensation; Value → Ethics |
| Labor Market | Society → Market | Work → Project; Value → Benefit |
| Language Model | Technology → AI Model | Language → Text; Value → Standard |
| Opportunity Cost | Value → Cost | Work → Goal; Society → Market |
